actions.action: 从 Patrick 家回到家，发现 François 正在墨西哥买的羊毛地毯（“the deity”）上尿尿；她伸手摸湿处确认是真尿，把地毯对折两次搬到浴缸冲洗。

anchors.anchor: When I got home from Patrick’s, there was François, pissing on our rug.
François was pissing on the deity.
I touched the wet spot on the rug
I folded the rug in half, in half again, and brought it to the bathtub to rinse out.

actions.action: François 尖叫，她吐回去“What do you want me to do?”，并像 Mark 姐姐说的“婴儿哭我也哭”那样对着他壕叫。

anchors.anchor: François started to scream so I screamed back

actions.action: 想要帮助与睡眠、想要朋友回来，但不知向谁求助；记起抽屉里 Manhattan Remediation 的号码，拿起电话犹豫后拨号。

anchors.anchor: I still had the number for Manhattan Remediation in my junk drawer.
I picked up the phone. He kept screaming. I hesitated. I dialed.

actions.action: 接线员 Marta 按话术报出机构名，她只说“I need help.”；被追问是哪种 “sensorial encounter” 时，她只答”他叫得很多”。

anchors.anchor: Manhattan Remediation, this is Marta, how may I be of assistance today?
There’s a presence here who won’t leave, and I really need to get some sleep.

actions.action: 做接诊对答：她只承认认识对方、关系是朋友兼邻居、年龄猜 Thirty-five-ish；隐瞬死因只说他长过脑瘤；Marta 说要派资深技术员 Dr. Silverman。

anchors.anchor: Friend. Neighbor. Why?
I just said he’d had a brain tumor.
I’ll send over Dr. Silverman,

actions.action: 挂电话后 François 安静下来，她坐到地板上仰视他，告诉他“Mark died”，并哭着追问他知不知道、在不在意。

anchors.anchor: Mark died

actions.action: 她对 François 说他已经死了、不必再疛痛、可以安息；他回应低语“Non non non.”，随后飘下来第一次直视她，两人都哭，她像念咒般不停道歉。

anchors.anchor: Do you know that you’re dead, François? You don’t have to hurt like this anymore.
Non non non.
He floated down and, for the first time, looked at me straight.

actions.action: 有人敲门，她惊跳；两人都转向门，门外男人说“You reported a disturbance, ma’am?”

anchors.anchor: Someone knocked, and I jumped.
You reported a disturbance, ma’am?

turning_point.text: 转折点：她拨通 Manhattan Remediation（而且在接诊中隐瞬死因、只说脑瘤）之后，François 安静下来；她终于把“你已经死了、可以休息”说出口，他第一次直视她——紧接着门被敲响（她抬来的“治理”人员上门）。

anchors.anchor: Friend. Neighbor. Why?
He had died of complications (don’t we all) from encephalopathy
His face had gotten so eaten up by KS you could barely distinguish his features.
